notes.title: CPUCores ADVANCED is officially released today!
notes.content:
[b]Smorb Software Presents: CPUCores ADVANCED – The Next Level of Gaming Performance[/b]

Smorb Software is thrilled to announce the worldwide release of [b]CPUCores ADVANCED[/b], our most powerful and sophisticated performance-boosting software yet. Designed by gamers, for gamers, CPUCores ADVANCED is available now on all platforms—and we couldn’t be more excited to share it with you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9260919/ef65ae301d9578dd7a94f3ed91dd1c8cd0835689.jpg[/img]

[b]What’s New in CPUCores ADVANCED?[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Modernized Interface[/b]: Enjoy a fresh, intuitive GUI for easier navigation.
[*] [b]Optimized for Windows 10/11[/b]: Experience seamless performance on the latest operating systems.
[*] [b]Integrated DLC[/b]: All previous DLC from the original CPUCores is now included.
[*] [b]New Achievements[/b]: Unlock achievements and showcase your system-tuning prowess.
[*] [b]Enhanced Error Logs & Bug Reporting[/b]: Quickly spot and resolve issues.
[*] [b]Discord Community[/b]: Join our growing community for support, tips, and more.
[*] [b]Community Game Servers[/b]: Play together on official servers for popular games like Minecraft and more!
[/list]

[b]A Long Road to a Major Update[/b]
Since 2022, our goal has been to create a successor to the incredibly popular CPUCores. Although the journey took longer than we planned—and had some unintended twists and turns—we’re confident that CPUCores ADVANCED in 2025 surpasses our original vision. This update arrives as a significant leap forward, building on the best of the original CPUCores.

[b]Community Servers & Events[/b]
Later this month, we’ll roll out official [b]Community Servers[/b], hosting free game servers for titles the community votes on. Our first server—featuring the brand-new “All The Mods 10” Minecraft modpack—is already set up and ready for adventurers. If you have server-management experience or simply want to help moderate these servers, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit an application in our [url=https://discord.gg/D2NhNXwHYE]Discord[/url].

[b]The “Gains Challenge” Returns[/b]
We’re excited to announce the formal launch of our monthly [b]“Gains Challenge,”[/b] where we spotlight the best performance boosts submitted by our community. Share your FPS or other performance improvements using CPUCores ADVANCED, and you could win bragging rights and prizes! Head over to the [url=https://discord.gg/D2NhNXwHYE]Discord[/url] channel for more information and to participate.

[b]Thank You from Smorb Software[/b]
As the head of Smorb Software, I’m incredibly proud of the tireless work our development team has poured into CPUCores ADVANCED. We have a dedicated support team standing by to tackle bugs and push out updates as needed. Our commitment is to deliver the smoothest, most optimized gaming experience possible—and we’re just getting started.

Once again, thank you for joining us on this journey. Your feedback, enthusiasm, and support make all the difference. Let’s keep pushing the boundaries of gaming performance together!

- Dan Adams
CEO, Smorb Software
[url=https://cpucores.com]cpucores.com[/url]

notes.title: UPDATE on GamingVPN - A VPN made just for gamers, created by us!
notes.content:
I have a quick update on my new project, GamingVPN.  We are a privacy and security focused premium VPN provider which is focused around creating the best solution for PC Gamers. 

[url=https://GamingVPN.com]https://GamingVPN.com[/url]  

I'm extremely excited to announce that we are approximately 95% ready for our first BETA test!  If you're interested, fill out the "Notify me" area on the website and I'll contact you personally when we are ready for testing.  Note, all BETA testing is FREE.  

[h3]So what exactly is GamingVPN?[/h3]

I'm building a VPN service that caters to gamers.  Here are a couple examples:

1)  The GamingVPN service runs dramatically faster on your PC, something that is critical to today's competitive gaming scene.  This means our solution is up to 800% faster than competitor VPN products.  For example, we've done benchmarks that show a 300MB/s download over our VPN uses 1/8th the processing power of our competitors.  Less processing power for your VPN = more processing power for your games to use.  It's that simple.

2)  Our VPN service is not oversold.  Typical VPN providers try to pack as many users in on a server as possible.  Our solution actually does the opposite.  We've pioneered backend AI to ensure that you are always able to use a VPN server that is as fast as possible.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9260919/48d59b76314bccf417ea1ce0e2c9386738eba722.png[/img]

Here are couple more examples:  

3)  Dual VPN by default.  Our VPN service is actually 2 VPNs in 1.  We've pioneered a technology enable to you to things like download video, files, and heavy duty usage over 1 VPN, while still allowing you to have low latency, ultra fast access for things like competitive gaming over another VPN.  This enables your downloads to not slow down your gaming. 

4)  Unique Application -> VPN support.  We've pioneered a technology enabling you to pick what application uses which VPN, or no VPN at all, on a per-application basis.  For example, want to use Steam without a VPN, yet stream video using Firefox WITH a VPN?  You can now easily do that!

If you'd like to learn more, please sign up for the BETA and stay tuned!


[url=https://GamingVPN.com]https://GamingVPN.com[/url]

notes.title: CPUCores Planned Update - Additional Achievements!
notes.content:
[h1]CPUCores was built to do 1 thing and 1 thing only:  Increase your FPS![/h1]  
In addition to increasing your FPS, we are now working on adding more achievements to the software!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9260919/424e5248941b732f120f806b2eb750563f53fa9a.png[/img]

One thing CPUCores users seem to be passionate about is achievements.  We've created a bunch of achievements already based upon the number of processor cores you have, as well as the amount of time you have used the software.   Take a look at our existing achievements here:  https://steamcommunity.com/stats/384300/achievements

We have seen a lot of users asking for more achievements to be added to CPUCores.  We agree, this could be a fun way to add some extra excitement to what is already an extremely exciting software (haha) :)

We have thought of some potential new achievements and we would love to run these ideas by our users, you, as well as seek feedback on what achievement updates you would like to see. 

[h1]New CPUCores Potential Achievements:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Increase the number of "Timed Achievements" to include:  1250 Hours, 1500 Hours, 2500 Hours, and 3000 Hours used, and possibly even more.
    [*]Create new achievements based upon your unique processor/CPU information.  For example, an achievement for the type of processor you have (Intel vs AMD) and such.
    [*]Create more hardware-specific achievements, such as one for having 1 Hard Drive, another achievement for having 2 Hard Drives, and more.
[/list]

What are your thoughts?  What sorts of achievements would you like us to add?  Please let us know by posting your thoughts on this forum topic here:  https://steamcommunity.com/app/384300/discussions/0/2980782118457621179/

Thanks!!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/384300/CPUCores__Maximize_Your_FPS/

[h1]Prior Recent CPUCores Updates:[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Internal efficiency update - slightly better performance!
    [*]Restructure of top menu of CPUCores - better DLC options!
    [*]Added a "More By Us" button to show things we are working on!
    [*]CPUCores has better Windows 7 support.  It will now detect/install Microsoft .NET 4.5.2 if needed.
    [*]A framework has been added to allow for more DLC additions in the future, such as the ClearMem Lite DLC (upcoming).
    [*]CPUCores now fully supports Steam's Family Sharing!  (Pending Steam Client Changes by Valve)
    [*]A slight tweak has been made to CPUCore's internal engine to increase FPS when Task Manager is enabled.  
    [*]Games should load a bit more smoothly when launching CPUCores.
    [*]A bug has been found with a small portion of users who, upon starting CPUCores, don't see the actual program on their screen.  This has since been resolved!
    [*]A major bug with the CPUCores Service has been found.  The Service has since been removed and it has reverted back to the original and STABLE "core" behind CPUCores.  
  [*]A bug affecting PUGB (Playerunknowns Battleground) with CPUCores has been resolved.  You can now use CPUCores to stablize PUBG FPS once again!
  [*]A major bug affecting upgrading/installing CPUCores has been resolved!
  [*]CPUCores is once again very stable!
    [*]New Achievements!  CPUCores now has new time-based achievements.  This will trigger based on the amount of time you've used the software.  Note:  This requires your profile to (temporarily) be made public for the achievement to register.  Note #2:  There are fun things planned for these achievements including... CONTESTS! 
    [*]CPUCores now has shortcuts to a Steam game's forums + Steam page directly inside the CPUCores application.  Simply click the icon next to the game and you'll be taken right to the Steam page/forum!
    [*]A bug with clicking the "Grid" option in CPUCores when initially scanning for games has now been fixed.  You must now wait for the game scan to complete before enabling "Grid" mode. 
    [*]The "Constrain Web Browsers" option has been tweaked!
    [*]CPUCores now has a custom DLC "System Hardware Analyzer" !
    [*]AMD Ryzen CPU Support!  CPUCores has been updated to now work with AMD's latest processors.  The software will now automatically detect and configure itself to work with your AMD (or Intel) CPU.
    [*]VR Support!  CPUCores now has direct support for the Steam VR headset (Vive) as well as the Oculus Rift!
    [*]Game Probe Detection has been upgraded and improved!  This will allow you to automatically detect a game and engage CPUCores!
[/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/384300

[h1]More Prior Recent CPUCores Updates:[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Favorites List has been added!  You can now flag a game as a favorite and sort it to the top of your Steam games list!
    [*]Real-time Process List has been improved!  You can now scan your system's processes and pick one to "CPUCores It" in a much more streamlined fashion!
    [*]Supports Steam Libraries > 1000 games!  CPUCores Steam game detection has been streamlined to better support users with HUGE Steam libraries!
    [*]Various minor bug fixes including a license box pop-up, Game Probe Detection auto-starting when it shouldn't, and more.
    [*]Modified the method in which CPUCores communicates with Steam to validate your purchase.  This should address the rare bug with a Steam user encountering the "Enter your license key" message from CPUCores.  A big thanks to everybody for your patience while we worked on resolving this issue!
    [*]Improved the Game Probe Detection (BETA) by modifying the internal mechanics of how game scanning and activation/pausing work.  This should improve handling of CPUCores when pausing it's operation while a game/program you've listed is still running and needs CPUCores to be set to the "pause" position.
    [*]Added support for Steam Launch Parameters!  This enables you to set game-specific launch parameters for Steam, of which CPUCores' Steam integration will handle correctly.  
    [*]Modified how CPUCores shows up in Steam for "Time played" due to Steam's internal API better handling of non-game software.  Your hours accrued using CPUCores should now be better reflected, versus the past only showing often 0.2 hours despite potentially using it for hundreds of hours.
    [*]Streamlined the software to make it FASTER and better supporting games which use launchers as well as non-Steam games!
    [*]Added better support for Windows 10 multi-user environments and custom User Account Security
    [*]Added a Windows Notification Icon which has several options including the ability to reset the window position of CPUCores.  This can be advantageous for people who have multiple monitors and frequently add/remove monitors which can sometimes cause a program such as CPUCores to appear on a "phantom monitor".
    [*]Added better support for detecting games in Custom Steam Libraries.  Just go into the Advanced->Steam->Steam Config and add the base location of your additional/custom Steam game libraries.
    [*]Added major new performance methods to run your games even faster!
    [*]Added support for 18 more languages.
    [*]Added a link to an instructions manual for CPUCores.
    [*]Added new achievements based on your CPU.
    [*]Added better support for varied Windows 7/8/10 UAC and multiple Windows accounts.
    [*]Tweaked some default settings to better support more modern games
    [*]Added a Twitter Button - Please click and Tweet about CPUCores!
    [*]CPUCores is now multi-lingual!  We support the following languages:  English, German, Russian, Chinese, Polish, Korean, and French.  More will be added upon request!
    [*]Language settings are auto-detected but can be tweaked in the "Advanced->Languages" area.  
    [*]Windows 10 Microsoft Signature added
    [*]Increased support for Logitech mouse drivers
    [*]Improved handling of the internal CPUCores processes
    [*]Increased Windows 8 + 10 process efficiency handling 
[/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/384300

[b]Note[/b]:  You may wish to rebuild your CPUCores configuration file after this update.  While this is not required, it may help if you run into an update issue.  To do so, follow the instructions below:

[list]
    [*]Close CPUCores
    [*]Open Windows Explorer
    [*]Open the following folder:   %appdata%\CPUCores
    [*]Delete the following file:   cpucores.data
    [*]Restart CPUCores
[/list]

Check out the CPUCores Manual here:  https://store.steampowered.com/manual/384300

I hope you enjoy these new updates!  

Happy gaming!!

~~StartupTim

notes.title: CPUCores Update 1.9.9 - New "Start Random Game" Feature!
notes.content:
[h1]CPUCores was built to do 1 thing and 1 thing only:  Increase your FPS![/h1]  Version 1.9.9 has been released:  New "Start Random Game" Feature!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9260919/a33405ffc136fbd64bf4353cc2fc31ea5c11175c.gif[/img]

[h1]New CPUCores Updates:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]New "Start Random Game" Feature!
    [*]Internal Optimization of Game vs Non-Game listing
[/list]

As a fun new update, I've added a "Start Random Game" feature to CPUCores.  This feature will will enable you a 1-button click to start up any game, randomly, giving you the ability to truly randomize which game you're about to play.

This new feature will allow you to explore games that you may have ignored over time and breathe some extra life into your otherwise ever-expanding Steam library.

This feature came to be out of the numerous requests I've found online of people wanted to randomly be able to select a game.  These requests seem to come from people who a)  Have large Steam libraries, or b)  Who have games ignored for years, and even c)  Who do live Twitch/Youtube streams and want an additional way to interact with their gaming communities.


http://store.steampowered.com/app/384300/CPUCores__Maximize_Your_FPS/

[h1]Prior Recent CPUCores Updates:[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Internal efficiency update - slightly better performance!
    [*]Restructure of top menu of CPUCores - better DLC options!
    [*]Added a "More By Us" button to show things we are working on!
    [*]CPUCores has better Windows 7 support.  It will now detect/install Microsoft .NET 4.5.2 if needed.
    [*]A framework has been added to allow for more DLC additions in the future, such as the ClearMem Lite DLC (upcoming).
    [*]CPUCores now fully supports Steam's Family Sharing!  (Pending Steam Client Changes by Valve)
    [*]A slight tweak has been made to CPUCore's internal engine to increase FPS when Task Manager is enabled.  
    [*]Games should load a bit more smoothly when launching CPUCores.
    [*]A bug has been found with a small portion of users who, upon starting CPUCores, don't see the actual program on their screen.  This has since been resolved!
    [*]A major bug with the CPUCores Service has been found.  The Service has since been removed and it has reverted back to the original and STABLE "core" behind CPUCores.  
  [*]A bug affecting PUGB (Playerunknowns Battleground) with CPUCores has been resolved.  You can now use CPUCores to stablize PUBG FPS once again!
  [*]A major bug affecting upgrading/installing CPUCores has been resolved!
  [*]CPUCores is once again very stable!
    [*]New Achievements!  CPUCores now has new time-based achievements.  This will trigger based on the amount of time you've used the software.  Note:  This requires your profile to (temporarily) be made public for the achievement to register.  Note #2:  There are fun things planned for these achievements including... CONTESTS! 
    [*]CPUCores now has shortcuts to a Steam game's forums + Steam page directly inside the CPUCores application.  Simply click the icon next to the game and you'll be taken right to the Steam page/forum!
    [*]A bug with clicking the "Grid" option in CPUCores when initially scanning for games has now been fixed.  You must now wait for the game scan to complete before enabling "Grid" mode. 
    [*]The "Constrain Web Browsers" option has been tweaked!
    [*]CPUCores now has a custom DLC "System Hardware Analyzer" !
    [*]AMD Ryzen CPU Support!  CPUCores has been updated to now work with AMD's latest processors.  The software will now automatically detect and configure itself to work with your AMD (or Intel) CPU.
    [*]VR Support!  CPUCores now has direct support for the Steam VR headset (Vive) as well as the Oculus Rift!
    [*]Game Probe Detection has been upgraded and improved!  This will allow you to automatically detect a game and engage CPUCores!
[/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/384300

[h1]More Prior Recent CPUCores Updates:[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Favorites List has been added!  You can now flag a game as a favorite and sort it to the top of your Steam games list!
    [*]Real-time Process List has been improved!  You can now scan your system's processes and pick one to "CPUCores It" in a much more streamlined fashion!
    [*]Supports Steam Libraries > 1000 games!  CPUCores Steam game detection has been streamlined to better support users with HUGE Steam libraries!
    [*]Various minor bug fixes including a license box pop-up, Game Probe Detection auto-starting when it shouldn't, and more.
    [*]Modified the method in which CPUCores communicates with Steam to validate your purchase.  This should address the rare bug with a Steam user encountering the "Enter your license key" message from CPUCores.  A big thanks to everybody for your patience while we worked on resolving this issue!
    [*]Improved the Game Probe Detection (BETA) by modifying the internal mechanics of how game scanning and activation/pausing work.  This should improve handling of CPUCores when pausing it's operation while a game/program you've listed is still running and needs CPUCores to be set to the "pause" position.
    [*]Added support for Steam Launch Parameters!  This enables you to set game-specific launch parameters for Steam, of which CPUCores' Steam integration will handle correctly.  
    [*]Modified how CPUCores shows up in Steam for "Time played" due to Steam's internal API better handling of non-game software.  Your hours accrued using CPUCores should now be better reflected, versus the past only showing often 0.2 hours despite potentially using it for hundreds of hours.
    [*]Streamlined the software to make it FASTER and better supporting games which use launchers as well as non-Steam games!
    [*]Added better support for Windows 10 multi-user environments and custom User Account Security
    [*]Added a Windows Notification Icon which has several options including the ability to reset the window position of CPUCores.  This can be advantageous for people who have multiple monitors and frequently add/remove monitors which can sometimes cause a program such as CPUCores to appear on a "phantom monitor".
    [*]Added better support for detecting games in Custom Steam Libraries.  Just go into the Advanced->Steam->Steam Config and add the base location of your additional/custom Steam game libraries.
    [*]Added major new performance methods to run your games even faster!
    [*]Added support for 18 more languages.
    [*]Added a link to an instructions manual for CPUCores.
    [*]Added new achievements based on your CPU.
    [*]Added better support for varied Windows 7/8/10 UAC and multiple Windows accounts.
    [*]Tweaked some default settings to better support more modern games
    [*]Added a Twitter Button - Please click and Tweet about CPUCores!
    [*]CPUCores is now multi-lingual!  We support the following languages:  English, German, Russian, Chinese, Polish, Korean, and French.  More will be added upon request!
    [*]Language settings are auto-detected but can be tweaked in the "Advanced->Languages" area.  
    [*]Windows 10 Microsoft Signature added
    [*]Increased support for Logitech mouse drivers
    [*]Improved handling of the internal CPUCores processes
    [*]Increased Windows 8 + 10 process efficiency handling 
[/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/384300

[b]Note[/b]:  You may wish to rebuild your CPUCores configuration file after this update.  While this is not required, it may help if you run into an update issue.  To do so, follow the instructions below:

[list]
    [*]Close CPUCores
    [*]Open Windows Explorer
    [*]Open the following folder:   %appdata%\CPUCores
    [*]Delete the following file:   cpucores.data
    [*]Restart CPUCores
[/list]

Check out the CPUCores Manual here:  https://store.steampowered.com/manual/384300

I hope you enjoy these new updates!  

Happy gaming!!

~~StartupTim

notes.title: CPUCores March 2018: More Updates!
notes.content:
[h1]Want even more FPS gains?  You got it![/h1]

CPUCores is getting even more significant upgrades in the near future!

CPUCores was first released on Steam on July of 2015. Since then it has had around 25+ major updates (announced), with around 20 more minor updates (unannounced). During that time, we've released tons of new features, enhancements, and improved support. 

[b]We aren't stopping there![/b]

Here are some updates that are being worked on:
[list]
    [*]Re-release of our "service based engine".  We are working on tweaking our prior test release of a service-based method for the software to internally make FPS-improving tweaks.  This development is a ways away, though once finished, it should provide even more FPS gains.
    [*]Ability to hide games from your CPUCores Steam game list.  By popular demand, we are added the ability to hide games in your Steam library from the list that is shown via CPUCores.
    [*]Further tweaks to the Game Probe Detection (GPD) feature of CPUCores.  This will enable you to easily scan your processes and add games to your GPD list and save them there, allow multiple games to automatically be detected by CPUCores and have CPUCores auto-engage when a game is seen to be running.
    [*]Better support for more languages!
[/list] 

Further, we've opened up a discussion thread to hear what YOU would like added to CPUCores.  See here:  https://steamcommunity.com/app/384300/discussions/0/1698293255123024171/

Cheers!

@StartupTim

http://store.steampowered.com/app/384300/CPUCores__Maximize_Your_FPS/

notes.content:
[h1]CPUCores was built to do 1 thing and 1 thing only:  Increase your FPS![/h1]  
Version 1.9.5 has been released - FPS update + Family Sharing!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9260919/1aa1ab7f9f559fc623ac81fee787e4be90f4c7b3.gif[/img]

[h1]New CPUCores Updates:[/h1]

    [*]A slight tweak has been made to CPUCore's internal engine to increase FPS when Task Manager is enabled.  
    [*]Games should load a bit more smoothly when launching CPUCores.
[/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/384300/CPUCores__Maximize_Your_FPS/

[h1]Prior Recent CPUCores Updates:[/h1]

[list]
    [*]A bug has been found with a small portion of users who, upon starting CPUCores, don't see the actual program on their screen.  This has since been resolved!
    [*]A major bug with the CPUCores Service has been found.  The Service has since been removed and it has reverted back to the original and STABLE "core" behind CPUCores.  
  [*]A bug affecting PUGB (Playerunknowns Battleground) with CPUCores has been resolved.  You can now use CPUCores to stablize PUBG FPS once again!
  [*]A major bug affecting upgrading/installing CPUCores has been resolved!
  [*]CPUCores is once again very stable!
    [*]New Achievements!  CPUCores now has new time-based achievements.  This will trigger based on the amount of time you've used the software.     [*]CPUCores now has shortcuts to a Steam game's forums + Steam page directly inside the CPUCores application.  Simply click the icon next to the game and you'll be taken right to the Steam page/forum!
    [*]A bug with clicking the "Grid" option in CPUCores when initially scanning for games has now been fixed.  You must now wait for the game scan to complete before enabling "Grid" mode. 
    [*]The "Constrain Web Browsers" option has been tweaked!
    [*]CPUCores now has a custom DLC "System Hardware Analyzer" !

Enjoy!!

    [*]Improved handling of the internal CPUCores processes
    [*]Increased Windows 8 + 10 process efficiency handling 
[/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/384300

[list]

Happy gaming!!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/384300

    [*]CPUCores now analyzes and interacts with EVERY default Windows Service that you have running on your PC and makes internal adjustments to ensure you obtain maximum FPS gains while still having a stable OS.  You can choose to enable or disable this in the main option screen of CPUCores.
    [*]CPUCores how has a "Disable XBox" option to disable all the XBox processes/services while running Steam games.  This option can also be enabled/disabled should you need to use XBox services.
    [*]CPUCores now has a "core parking" buster built in.  While it is rare that your system would park cores when using CPUCores in the past, it definitely won't anymore!
    [*]New Achievements!  CPUCores now has new time-based achievements.  This will trigger based on the amount of time you've used the software.  Note:  This requires your profile to (temporarily) be made public for the achievement to register.  Note #2:  There are fun things planned for these achievements including... CONTESTS! 
    [*]CPUCores now examines your Windows Power Profile and makes adjustments when you play a game, as well as reverts those adjustments when you're finished playing a game.  This will allow you to maximize your FPS while still maximizing your power profile (and thus extending battery life on laptops).
    [*]CPUCores now has shortcuts to a Steam game's forums + Steam page directly inside the CPUCores application.  Simply click the icon next to the game and you'll be taken right to the Steam page/forum!
    [*]CPUCores now has extended command-line options!  You can create custom .bat files to start CPUCores + a Steam game, all with 1 click!  For example:   cpucores.exe /startgame <appid> (will start game after finishing loading)   or   cpucores.exe /stop (stops any running process in service then shuts down cc again)

[/list]

CPUCores has been updated with a brand new feature, currently in BETA, which we are calling our Game Probe Detection!  

This new feature will allow you to input the .EXE of any game(s).  Upon entering the game's .EXE file, you may then minimize CPUCores and then launch your game via whatever means you may have.  

After inputting your game, CPUCores will "probe" your system continually until the game is launched.  Once CPUCores detects the game has having been launched, CPUCores will automatically engage it's "START GAME" button and thus do everything that CPUCores is configured to do!  Once you are finished gaming, simply close your game and click the "STOP CPUCORES" button. 

This new update includes supports for games that require web-based launchers such as Battlefield 1, as well as classic game launchers including Battle . net, as well as any customer game launcher such as SKSE, F4SE, etc.  

I hope you enjoy this new feature!  As it is currently in BETA and is being enhanced, please report any bugs/ideas about this new feature directly to our Steam forums.  

Enjoy!!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/384300

    [*]Improved the Game Probe Detection (BETA) by modifying the internal mechanics of how game scanning and activation/pausing work.  This should improve handling of CPUCores when pausing it's operation while a game/program you've listed is still running and needs CPUCores to be set to the "pause" position.
    [*]Added support for Steam Launch Parameters!  This enables you to set game-specific launch parameters for Steam, of which CPUCores' Steam integration will handle correctly.  
    [*]Modified how CPUCores shows up in Steam for "Time played" due to Steam's internal API better handling of non-game software.  Your hours accrued using CPUCores should now be better reflected, versus the past only showing often 0.2 hours despite potentially using it for hundreds of hours.
    [*]Streamlined the software to make it FASTER and better supporting games which use launchers as well as non-Steam games!

This can be advantageous for people who have multiple monitors and frequently add/remove monitors which can sometimes cause a program such as CPUCores to appear on a "phantom monitor".

    [*]Added a link to an instructions manual for CPUCores.
    [*]Added new achievements based on your CPU.

    [*]Tweaked some default settings to better support more modern games
    [*]Added a Twitter Button - Please click and Tweet about CPUCores!
    [*]CPUCores is now multi-lingual!  We support the following languages:  English, German, Russian, Chinese, Polish, Korean, and French.  More will be added upon request!
    [*]Language settings are auto-detected but can be tweaked in the "Advanced->Languages" area.  
    [*]Windows 10 Microsoft Signature added
    [*]Increased support for Logitech mouse drivers
    [*]Improved handling of the internal CPUCores processes
    [*]Increased Windows 8 + 10 process efficiency handling 
[/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/384300

[b]Note[/b]:  You may wish to rebuild your CPUCores configuration file after this update.  While this is not required, it may help if you run into an update issue.  To do so, follow the instructions below:

[list]

    [*]Open the following folder:   %appdata%\CPUCores
    [*]Delete the following file:   cpucores.data
    [*]Restart CPUCores
[/list]

Happy gaming!!

Tim

tags.balance_change: The "Constrain Web Browsers" option has been tweaked!

tags.feature: CPUCores now has a custom DLC "System Hardware Analyzer" being released October 12th, 2017.  Below is the link:
AMD Ryzen CPU Support!  CPUCores has been updated to now work with AMD's latest processors.  The software will now automatically detect and configure itself to work with your AMD (or Intel) CPU.
VR Support!  CPUCores now has direct support for the Steam VR headset (Vive) as well as the Oculus Rift!
Game Probe Detection has been upgraded and improved!  This will allow you to automatically detect a game and engage CPUCores!
CPUCores has been updated with a brand new feature, currently in BETA, which we are calling our Game Probe Detection!

This new update includes supports for games that require web-based launchers such as Battlefield 1, as well as classic game launchers including Battle . net, as well as any customer game launcher such as SKSE, F4SE, etc.  

I hope you enjoy this new feature!  As it is currently in BETA and is being enhanced, please report any bugs/ideas about this new feature directly to our Steam forums.  

Enjoy!!

Tim

notes.title: CPUCores Update 1.8.2 - Major Update!
notes.content:
[h1]CPUCores was built to do 1 thing and 1 thing only:  Increase your FPS![/h1]  
Version 1.8.2 has been released - This is a Major Update!!!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9260919/c9f80639051d0370e5d36c3dddc9d9773cb2e9c6.png[/img]

[h1]New CPUCores 1.8.2 Updates:[/h1]

[list]
[*]   CPUCores has had a major GUI update!  The software now is more streamlined and runs faster than ever!
[*]   CPUCores now has a much better Japanese language translation for the application.  Japanese users rejoice! ːsteamhappyː
[*]   You can now directly edit a Steam detected game's title as well as image right inside the software.  This allows you to rename and better organize your auto-detected library of games!
[*]   CPUCores now supports command-line arguments to automatically start a game with CPUCores without using the GUI!   To do so, simply navigate to the CPUCores.exe file and type a command such as:   cpucores.exe /startgame 730          You would then type the appID for the game itself (730 is CS:GO)
[*]   CPUCores now remembers the last screen you had open when you closed it and then returns to your last screen when re-opened.
[*]   The Game Probe Detection feature has been tweaked to run even better!
[*]   Some of the CPUCores art graphics have been updated!
[/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/384300

!!! Please Note !!!    You may need to delete your old CPUCores configuration prior to running this new update.  To see how just scroll to the bottom of this update release for instructions.

[b]CPUCores has been updated recently which features our automatic Game Probe Detection![/b]

[h1]About Game Probe Detection:[/h1]

CPUCores has been updated with a brand new feature, currently in BETA, which we are calling our Game Probe Detection!  

This new feature will allow you to input the .EXE of any game(s).  Upon entering the game's .EXE file, you may then minimize CPUCores and then launch your game via whatever means you may have.  

After inputting your game, CPUCores will "probe" your system continually until the game is launched.  Once CPUCores detects the game has having been launched, CPUCores will automatically engage it's "START GAME" button and thus do everything that CPUCores is configured to do!  Once you are finished gaming, simply close your game and click the "STOP CPUCORES" button. 

This new update includes supports for games that require web-based launchers such as Battlefield 1, as well as classic game launchers including Battle . net, as well as any customer game launcher such as SKSE, F4SE, etc.  

I hope you enjoy this new feature!  As it is currently in BETA and is being enhanced, please report any bugs/ideas about this new feature directly to our Steam forums.  

Enjoy!!

[h1]Prior Recent CPUCores Updates:[/h1]

[list]
[*]   The CPUCores application has been updated to better support our incredible Chinese users!  Thanks to a few people in the Chinese community, the software now has immensely better Chinese translations.  Many thanks to Flan as well as TeRRy$ for their incredible help!!
[*]   The CPUCores Steam website has been translated into Chinese.  Yay to our Chinese users!!! ːsteamhappyː
[*]   CPUCores is testing 2 month long 25% off sale.  Our normal $19.99 price has been reduced to $14.99 for two months.  Enjoy the 25% discount!!! 
    [*]AMD Ryzen CPU Support!  CPUCores has been updated to now work with AMD's latest processors.  The software will now automatically detect and configure itself to work with your AMD (or Intel) CPU.
    [*]VR Support!  CPUCores now has direct support for the Steam VR headset (Vive) as well as the Oculus Rift!
    [*]Game Probe Detection has been upgraded and improved!  This will allow you to automatically detect a game and engage CPUCores!
    [*]Favorites List has been added!  You can now flag a game as a favorite and sort it to the top of your Steam games list!
    [*]Real-time Process List has been improved!  You can now scan your system's processes and pick one to "CPUCores It" in a much more streamlined fashion!
    [*]Supports Steam Libraries > 1000 games!  CPUCores Steam game detection has been streamlined to better support users with HUGE Steam libraries!
    [*]Various minor bug fixes including a license box pop-up, Game Probe Detection auto-starting when it shouldn't, and more.
    [*]Modified the method in which CPUCores communicates with Steam to validate your purchase.  This should address the rare bug with a Steam user encountering the "Enter your license key" message from CPUCores.  A big thanks to everybody for your patience while we worked on resolving this issue!
    [*]Improved the Game Probe Detection (BETA) by modifying the internal mechanics of how game scanning and activation/pausing work.  This should improve handling of CPUCores when pausing it's operation while a game/program you've listed is still running and needs CPUCores to be set to the "pause" position.
    [*]Added support for Steam Launch Parameters!  This enables you to set game-specific launch parameters for Steam, of which CPUCores' Steam integration will handle correctly.  
    [*]Modified how CPUCores shows up in Steam for "Time played" due to Steam's internal API better handling of non-game software.  Your hours accrued using CPUCores should now be better reflected, versus the past only showing often 0.2 hours despite potentially using it for hundreds of hours.
    [*]Streamlined the software to make it FASTER and better supporting games which use launchers as well as non-Steam games!
    [*]Added better support for Windows 10 multi-user environments and custom User Account Security
    [*]Added a Windows Notification Icon which has several options including the ability to reset the window position of CPUCores.  This can be advantageous for people who have multiple monitors and frequently add/remove monitors which can sometimes cause a program such as CPUCores to appear on a "phantom monitor".
    [*]Added better support for detecting games in Custom Steam Libraries.  Just go into the Advanced->Steam->Steam Config and add the base location of your additional/custom Steam game libraries.
    [*]Added major new performance methods to run your games even faster!
    [*]Added support for 18 more languages.
    [*]Added a link to an instructions manual for CPUCores.
    [*]Added new achievements based on your CPU.
    [*]Added better support for varied Windows 7/8/10 UAC and multiple Windows accounts.
    [*]Tweaked some default settings to better support more modern games
    [*]Added a Twitter Button - Please click and Tweet about CPUCores!
    [*]CPUCores is now multi-lingual!  We support the following languages:  English, German, Russian, Chinese, Polish, Korean, and French.  More will be added upon request!
    [*]Language settings are auto-detected but can be tweaked in the "Advanced->Languages" area.  
    [*]Windows 10 Microsoft Signature added
    [*]Increased support for Logitech mouse drivers
    [*]Improved handling of the internal CPUCores processes
    [*]Increased Windows 8 + 10 process efficiency handling 
[/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/384300

[b]Note[/b]:  You may wish to rebuild your CPUCores configuration file after this update.  While this is not required, it may help if you run into an update issue.  To do so, follow the instructions below:

[list]
    [*]Close CPUCores
    [*]Open Windows Explorer
    [*]Open the following folder:   %appdata%\CPUCores
    [*]Delete the following file:   cpucores.data
    [*]Restart CPUCores
[/list]

Happy gaming!!

Tim

notes.title: CPUCores has been updated to 1.6.0!
notes.content:
[h1]CPUCores was built to do 1 thing and 1 thing only:  Increase your FPS![/h1]  Version 1.6.0 has been released!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/98xjtTm.gif[/img]

[b]CPUCores has been updated!  Below are the recent update notes for the  1.6.0 update:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added support for Steam Launch Parameters!  This enables you to set game-specific launch parameters for Steam, of which CPUCores' Steam integration will handle correctly.  
    [*]Modified how CPUCores shows up in Steam for "Time played" due to Steam's internal API better handling of non-game software.  Your hours accrued using CPUCores should now be better reflected, versus the past only showing often 0.2 hours despite potentially using it for hundreds of hours.

And also: 

    [*]Streamlined the software to make it FASTER and better supporting games which use launchers as well as non-Steam games!
    [*]Added better support for Windows 10 multi-user environments and custom User Account Security
    [*]Added a Windows Notification Icon which has several options including the ability to reset the window position of CPUCores.  This can be advantageous for people who have multiple monitors and frequently add/remove monitors which can sometimes cause a program such as CPUCores to appear on a "phantom monitor".
    [*]Added better support for detecting games in Custom Steam Libraries.  Just go into the Advanced->Steam->Steam Config and add the base location of your additional/custom Steam game libraries.
    [*]Added major new performance methods to run your games even faster!
    [*]Added support for 18 more languages.
    [*]Added a link to an instructions manual for CPUCores.
    [*]Added new achievements based on your CPU.
    [*]Added better support for varied Windows 7/8/10 UAC and multiple Windows accounts.
    [*]Tweaked some default settings to better support more modern games
    [*]Added a Twitter Button - Please click and Tweet about CPUCores!
    [*]CPUCores is now multi-lingual!  We support the following languages:  English, German, Russian, Chinese, Polish, Korean, and French.  More will be added upon request!
    [*]Language settings are auto-detected but can be tweaked in the "Advanced->Languages" area.  
    [*]Windows 10 Microsoft Signature added
    [*]Increased support for Logitech mouse drivers
    [*]Improved handling of the internal CPUCores processes
    [*]Increased Windows 8 + 10 process efficiency handling 
[/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/384300

[b]Note[/b]:  You may wish to rebuild your CPUCores configuration file after this update.  While this is not required, it may help if you run into an update issue.  To do so, follow the instructions below:

[list]
    [*]Close CPUCores
    [*]Open Windows Explorer
    [*]Open the following folder:   %appdata%\CPUCores
    [*]Delete the following file:   cpucores.data
    [*]Restart CPUCores
[/list]

Happy gaming!!

Tim

notes.title: CPUCores updated to 1.3.2!
notes.content:
[h1]CPUCores version 1.3.2 Update[/h1]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/0wynNVb.gif[/img]

[b]CPUCores has been updated!  This is a major update to the software.  Below are the update notes for 1.3.0 to 1.3.2 updates:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Increased support for Windows 10
    [*]Renamed "UNDO" button to "RESET CPUCORES"
    [*]Introduction of CPUCores GUI color themes
    [*]Added feature distinction between AMD and Intel CPUs.
    [*]Better support for CPUs over 4 cores.
    [*]Full Launcher Support - CPUCores will now automatically scan for games triggered via a launcher for 120 seconds after "START GAMES" is clicked.  This includes full support for games like GTAV, Minecraft, Skyrim w/SKSE, etc.
    [*]Ability to "CPUCores It" to games which are launched outside of CPUCores.  This includes games such as Minecraft's server, games which use a web browser to launch, and more.
    [*]Major improvements to OS constraining methods, including specific attention to key Windows services, important Windows input processes, and more.
    [*]You can now constrain CPU resources to your web browser + flash players.  This includes Chrome, Firefox, and IE.  More browsers can be added depending on usage.
    [*]Advanced CPU core-targeting feature added for games which require a specific set number of cores, no more or no less.
    [*]Twitch streaming support added via stream software (OBS) CPU isolation.  You can now ensure that OBS will not "step into" CPU used by your game, and vice versa if enabled.  No more FPS drops due to streaming software CPU spikes!
    [*]Improved Steam Game Detection.
    [*]Ability to Whitelist an application to be ignored by CPUCores.
    [*]Ability to run CPUCores in the background should you only want the OS optimization and not anything game specific.
    [*]... as well as more minor changes.
[/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/384300

[b]Note[/b]:  You may wish to rebuild your CPUCores configuration file after this update.  To do so, follow the instructions below:

[list]
    [*]Close CPUCores
    [*]Open Windows Explorer
    [*]Open the following folder:   %appdata%\CPUCores
    [*]Delete the following file:   cpucores.data
    [*]Restart CPUCores
[/list]

Happy gaming!!

Cheers :)
Tim

notes.title: CPUCores has been updated to 1.2.3 - Minor Update
notes.content:
[h1]CPUCores version 1.2.3 Update[/h1]

[b]CPUCores has been updated!  Below is a quick summary of the changes:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added support for Intel 6 Core CPUs
    [*]Modified the "Game on dedicated core" option to better support single-threaded games as well as games that have low thread (aka low CPU) usage
    [*]Slight enhancement to the OS core isolation
[/list]

[b]Note[/b]:  If you have a 4+ core Intel CPU, you may want to delete your CPUCores configuration data file.  To do so, follow the instructions below:

[list]
    [*]Close CPUCores
    [*]Open Windows Explorer
    [*]Open the following folder:   %appdata%\CPUCores
    [*]Delete the following file:   cpucores.data
    [*]Restart CPUCores
[/list]

This is the first of many upcoming CPUCore updates!

Cheers :)
Tim
